sql/risk_report.sql:
WITH high_risk AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        t.tx_date,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY t.account_id
            ORDER BY t.tx_date
            RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS tx_count_30d
    FROM transactions t
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM risk_events re LEFT JOIN processed_transactions p USING(tx_id)
        WHERE re.tx_id = t.tx_id AND (p.result->>'risk_level'='High' OR (p.result IS NULL AND re.risk_score>=70))
    )
)
SELECT DISTINCT account_id
FROM high_risk
WHERE tx_count_30d > 3
ORDER BY account_id;
sql/monthly_summary.sql:
-- Net movement from a zero opening balance, separately for each currency.
-- Transfers are treated as outgoing in this teaching model.
SELECT
    account_id,
    currency,
    tx_date,
    tx_id,
    CASE WHEN tx_type IN ('credit') THEN amount ELSE -amount END AS signed_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN tx_type IN ('credit') THEN amount ELSE -amount END) OVER (
        PARTITION BY account_id, currency
        ORDER BY tx_date, tx_id
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_balance
FROM transactions
ORDER BY account_id, currency, tx_date, tx_id;
sql/views.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_account_summary AS
SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.account_type,
    a.balance,
    a.status,
    c.full_name AS customer_name,
    c.kyc_status,
    COUNT(t.tx_id) AS total_transactions,
    MAX(t.tx_date) AS last_tx_date,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(t.tx_id) = 0 THEN 0
         WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.currency) = 1 THEN SUM(t.amount)
         ELSE NULL END AS total_tx_value,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.currency) = 1 THEN MAX(t.currency)
         ELSE NULL END AS currency
FROM accounts a
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY a.account_id, a.account_type, a.balance, a.status,
         c.full_name, c.kyc_status;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_account_currency_summary AS
SELECT account_id, currency, COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
       SUM(amount) AS gross_amount
FROM transactions
GROUP BY account_id, currency;
